comment: Milestone 12, way A: fixed work areas and pool slots that are too small on LP64.
whole_prepare.py (lp64_sizes) wraps `expr` inside every `text` of the listed files in
RE4_LP64_SIZE(expr, lp64) (re4_whole_prelude.h): the GameCube value on ILP32, `lp64` on
64 bit. `count` is the number of places; another number stops the build.
Sizes from port/tools/m12/overlay_check.py (the largest class or work on LP64); `slot`
names the pool base class the check measures against the LP64 size. Heap blocks of a
fixed GameCube size and clears of a fixed length: port/tools/m12/alloc_size_check.py.

sizes.why: cManager<cEm> stride: cEm grows from 0x3E0 to 0x4A0 bytes, plus the LP64 free area 0xAC0
cEm::free of each enemy class: FREE_EM10/FREE_EM31 0xAB8, Em32Work 0xAB0, Em35Work 0xA98 on LP64
cManager<cObj> stride: cObj grows from 0x328 to 0x3C0 bytes, plus the LP64 free area 0xF0
cObj::free of each object class: FREE_OBJ13 0xF0, FREE_ROBO 0xE0, FREE_OBJ16 0xD0 on LP64
cEspgen::Free: ESPGEN45_WK 0xD0 on LP64 (the generator array uses sizeof(cEspgen))
esp pool slot (EspArray): the largest effect class, cEsp3f, has 0x1A8 bytes on LP64 (0x144 on ILP32; cEsp03/06/0e/4e 0x170)
esp pool slot (EspArray), the walks over the pool
esp pool slot (EspArray), cleared before reuse

esp pool slot (EspArray): EspDelete (an owner's effects) and EspDeleteEvent (the event's effects at its end) walked the pool in GameCube steps, kept the real effects and released pieces of others (fog stuck to the police car, grass in front of the camera in r120, 18.10.2026)

the attached camera of a model (MOTION_INFO::pAttachCam): 0xA0 bytes on LP64 (p_mat at 0x08); MotionMoveCore wrote its history past the block (heap cell broken, crash for a Ganado in r100, PC check 18.10.2026); port/tools/m12/alloc_size_check.py
